description: The apartment is a duplex on the fifth and top floor of the building, facing south, at the foot of the Liège metro station. Located between Saint Lazare and Place de Clichy, it is within easy reach of the Olympic Games village, numerous sports facilities and restaurants and bars. It has three bedrooms, including a master suite with dressing room, three bathrooms, and has been recently tastefully decorated. It has a large terrace with trees, a table, six chairs, a parasol and two outdoor sofas.
